items.text: Describes a system to identify, assess, control and review hazards before and during the event
items.sourceQuote: A system is in place for the identification, assessment, control and review of hazards before and during the event.

items.text: Assigns health and safety responsibilities to named staff, including volunteers
items.sourceQuote: Health and Safety responsibilities are assigned to designated staff including volunteers.

items.text: Confirms staff have the knowledge and skills for their jobs, or will be supervised
items.sourceQuote: All staff working at the event location have the necessary knowledge and skills to perform their job adequately, or will be adequately supervised.

items.text: Includes a plan to inspect the venue for safety before the event
items.sourceQuote: A plan is in place to inspect the event location to ensure that the venue is safe prior to the event.

items.text: States that an accident register is kept on site
items.sourceQuote: An Accident Register is kept on site.

items.text: Includes an emergency plan designed for this event
items.sourceQuote: An Emergency Plan designed for the event is in place for dealing with a variety of emergencies.

items.text: Describes a documented health and safety briefing for staff and volunteers before each session
items.sourceQuote: A Health and Safety briefing is carried out with staff (including volunteers) prior to each session of the event and is documented.

items.text: Describes how partners and suppliers work together so the public is not endangered
items.sourceQuote: A system is in place with the collaboration of all partners and suppliers to ensure the public is not endangered by activities carried out at the event venue.

sections: Hazard identification, assessment, control and review
